relationships.subject: keratinocytes
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, exclusive labeling of distinct immunoreactive puncta on both the keratinocytes and nerve fibers was observed with TRPV1-NB and TRPV1-AL antibodies.

key_findings: TRPV1-AL and TRPV1-NB antibodies specifically label TRPV1 on human skin nerve fibers and keratinocytes, validated in hTRPV1-HEK293 cells and by peptide pre-adsorption.
Machine-learning (Fiji) and deep-learning (Python) pipelines quantify TRPV1 puncta on nerve fibers reliably (ICC > 0.75).
